title: O! great our God the Almighty

lines.text: O! great our God the Almighty
We thank Thee for we're saved by grace
Witnessing this anniversary
Alive in this great universe.
We thank Thee, we thank Thee
For Thou preserved us till this day
Amidst all foes and adversaries
Amidst haters and talebearers
We thank Thee, we thank Thee
For Thou preserved us till this day.
We‘re alive to witness this day
Oh what a great Joy high above
For divine Band descending here
None like it ever here exist.
All the malefolks and female folks
Gird on thy loins and be ready
Let all the young and all the old
Rend holy songs in fellowship.
Witches, Wizards and the sorcerers
Demoniacs and wicked charmers
Evil forces and masquerades
Have no dominance on the Band.
At the inception of this Band
The mockers are all set to mock
In vain they thought the Band was found
They know not the mysteries of God.
Blessed Trinity is our God
Almighty God, Infinity
Father, Son and Holy Spirit
All working for purpose divine.
